title: A cool little 3D game experiment with Claude
author: FenixTzz
selftext:
I'm a web dev (until AI replaces me 😂), and I used my remaining weekly Claude Max usage to make this rough combat tech demo without spending anything.

Creating two different factions with light, medium, and heavy units, along with around 8 weapon variants, was surprisingly easy. The real challenge was making the 3D environment look natural, especially with linear level design. Open environments felt easier.

Back on Claude Pro now, so I probably won't finish it. Just a fun experiment!

Sorry for the rough video, I recorded it quickly just to share.
